## Summary

A brief description of the feature or command you'd like to see added.

## WAPI background

Which NIOS WAPI object type(s) would this feature interact with? (e.g. `record:a`, `member`, `network`)

Link to the relevant WAPI documentation section if available.

## Proposed command syntax

Show how you'd expect to invoke this from the ibcli REPL or batch mode:

```
configure <object> <action> <args>
```

## Use case

Describe the operational scenario this would support. What are you trying to accomplish?

## Alternatives considered

Have you worked around this using a different approach (e.g. direct WAPI calls, the GUI)? What are the limitations?

## Additional context

Any other context, example output, or references.
